extracted.name: Homemade Catalina Dressing
extracted.description: Homemade Catalina dressing tastes far better than store-bought, is quick to make with simple ingredients, and can be used as a marinade or on salads.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon salt-free Italian seasoning blend (such as Mrs. Dash® Italian Medley)
instruction_lines: Blend together sugar, red wine vinegar, canola oil, ketchup, paprika, onion powder, celery flakes, and Italian seasoning in a blender until smooth.
